title: OpenLabs lab metadata v1
description: Structural contract for catalogued lab metadata after YAML is parsed into a typed record. Repository-context rules (directory name, technique pages) are documented in contracts/README.md.

name.description: Lab slug; must match the labs/<track>/<name> directory name.

description.description: One-line summary for catalog and site indexes.

flag_hash.description: SHA-256 of the full flag string, lowercase hex.

status.description: Catalog support tier; supported requires separate L0-L6 evidence.

techniques.description: Technique slugs; each must have content/technique/<slug>.mdx (checked outside this schema).

checkpoint_flag_hash.description: Optional intermediate flag hash for multi-stage labs.

port.description: Optional documented host port when not inferred from README or compose.
